t: A compact open FPGA board with fast Ethernet, USB, and memory.
steps: Look for a ButterStick on Crowd Supply or GroupGets, or order a bare board from Tindie.
Install the open oss-cad-suite toolchain on your computer.
Add the udev rule on Linux to let your user reach the board.
Hold button 0 while plugging in USB-C to enter the bootloader.
Build the blink example from the ButterStick Verilog examples repo.
Flash it with dfu-util and watch the LEDs change.
Try the LiteX examples next to build a soft processor.
